title: Unitary designs from perturbed time evolutions of a chaotic Hamiltonian
summary: Unitary designs provide efficient substitutes for Haar-random unitaries in quantum information processing, randomized measurements, and many-body quantum dynamics. We propose a protocol based on time evolutions of a single chaotic Hamiltonian interleaved with unitary perturbations to generate unitary designs. We derive the frame potential of the resulting ensemble in terms of those of the intermediate ensemble.
